payload.name: ResolveRelativeTimeEventExtraction
payload.description: When a message mentions a past event or trip with a relative time expression, resolve it using the message timestamp and extract an event memory, even if the mention is casual or incidental.
content: During candidate extraction, identify statements that mention a past location, trip, or event with a relative time phrase (e.g., 'last summer', 'yesterday', 'two weeks ago').
Resolve the relative time phrase to an absolute date using the message/session timestamp (e.g., 'last summer' in a message from early 2023 means summer 2022).
Extract an event memory (type 'event') capturing the person, location/activity, and resolved absolute time, even if the mention is incidental or appears in a casual message.

solves: The construction agent failed to persist a past event mentioned with a relative time phrase in a casual message, leaving the fact missing. This Skill instructs extracting event memories for any past trips or events mentioned, resolving relative time to absolute time from the session timestamp, even when the mention is incidental.
